snippet.title: Infinite Lives (Teaser)
snippet.description:
The only thing better than "Extra Lives" is INFINITE LIVES! Plan A was to release a dedicated zombie game. Plan B was to release a dedicated superhero game. Plan C is to combine them into one mind-blowing farewell to 3D!

Although it's still fighting for its life, you can wish it into existence sooner rather than later on Steam and make the case for bringing it to other platforms:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751210/Infinite_Lives/

The song "All The Same (Nobody Changes)" appears courtesy of Bleeding Corpse, who you can find and support here:
https://www.bandlab.com/track/390bf936d0be49dda14dd68c125d500f_2a98d8102c85406ab4e8fdfbfe0cbda5
